title: kids_request
description: “Can I have more time?” (German “Can I have more time?”): a child device (parental controls) asks. category from client_config.kids.requests.categories; unlock_device needs entity_id of an entity the device sees; note optional (at most 80 characters, plain text). One open request per device; limits and cooldown from the house settings. Over the hub WebSocket; away from home (only with remote access, client_config.kids.away ha) the same message through the HA WebSocket command <ns>/family. Answer: kids_request_state (open) or family_error (requests_disabled, request_limit, cooldown, invalid_request).
